name: wildfire
job: Map burned land through smoke and cloud from the NISAR time series

labels.source: Sentinel-2 burn index (dNBR >= 0.27 on vegetation), tile 32SKF
labels.notes: Scores measure agreement with optical labels, not field truth or official perimeters

split: Spatial blocks within one fire complex; test cells not covered by any training patch
limits: Trained on one fire complex, one track (109 descending), ten Passes
Only 'burned' is learned; other change classes scored near zero and are not shown

On Washington (not retrained) it finds about a third of the optically burned land, but 91% of what it flags is burned; the Washington labels may also count late-summer drying of grass and shrubs as burned (dNBR from July to September), which lowers recall
Algeria's site box is larger than the training box; the edge strips are unseen ground
